action_items: Minor: Dashboard KPI cards, queue rows, and filter controls lack data-testid attributes; text-based selectors currently work but future tests would be more robust with data-testid.

Minor: Frontend Approval Rate shows 14.3% (1 of 7) while backend /api/analytics/approval-rate returns 16.7% (1 of 6). Possible off-by-one: backend may filter out drafts while frontend counts all proposals. Not blocking, but worth reconciling.
